scope: 2025 ICPC ECFinal A B H I J K L
limitations: Small-case independent checks, no online submissions or maximum-scale performance testing. A checks geometry formula implementation against official boundary characterization. H uses a corrected probability ratio.

A.method: exact rational-coordinate formula versus explicit translated-segment membership on 1705 points; not a tiling-structure proof

B.method: all complete three-letter strings of length 4/8 versus exhaustive parsing, plus 101 wildcard-count checks

H.method: 150 exact-rational comparisons against complete adaptive reroll decision trees

I.method: 1764 partial arrays against all completions, checking optimal span and constructed assignments

J.method: all 1441 labeled trees through 6 vertices; activated-set BFS optimum and reconstructed path legality

K.method: all 1441 labeled trees through 6 vertices; exhaustive maximum matching and encoded shuffled-edge reconstruction

L.method: all 5913 increasing trees through 8 vertices; parent directions, leaf complement, and exact inverse
